portability_changes: Example capture paths remain repository-relative placeholders; the method2 reference path resolves to the bundled data/communication-reference.csv.
Regression fixtures use the synthetic communication table; the original historical input is archived separately under data/.
Tests requiring private capture fixtures are skipped when those fixtures are absent.
The original machine-specific test import fallback was removed.
Regression tests were grouped under tests/ and optional standalone checks under tools/; runtime scripts and presentation assets are unchanged.

SWA and U diagnostic drill-downs add evidence only; original source/target cycle, TPOT and rank-selection formulas are unchanged. Repository iterations use branches and pull requests with offline regression checks.

Main CSA/HCA and draft SWA retain per-layer source evidence. Both method sheets now show core-provided target ten-stage estimates, target same-type all-layer totals and complete-cycle shares; only Dispatch, Combine and routed-GMM deltas modify source spans. The two U drill-downs remain measured and retained once. Parent cycle, TPOT, throughput and rank-selection formulas are unchanged; missing stage evidence only disables the affected target drill-down.

U charts can combine a verified all-round UNRESOLVED whole window with matched stages while preserving measured totals, counts, reasons and explicit partial-identification labels. Final Norm recognition accepts only a single explicit Index/Gather row-selection shape chain; ambiguous or insufficient evidence remains unresolved with bounded shape diagnostics. Core cycle, TPOT, throughput and target-layer estimates are unchanged.

Context-KV stages accept a shared positive num_context prefix of padded fused features while preserving hidden, projection, payload, slots and in-place cache checks. Packed UINT8 aliases compare by semantic dtype; bounded summary examples retain full per-round failure details in the stages CSV. Original cycle and extrapolation formulas are unchanged.

Independent cases can mix speculative-token counts and synthetic output lengths under an explicit mean accepted-draft fraction. Normalize num_speculative_tokens as the draft_tokens alias per configuration layer; case output policies override inherited fixed lengths and declared rates must agree with Neff=1+S*r. The template uses 60% instead of fixed Neff5.2. CSV, Excel and HTML display per-case parameters; existing timing formulas and BS grouping are unchanged.

Each case can supply only num_speculative_tokens and synthetic_acceptance_length; synthetic_acception_length is a compatible alias. Explicit case SAL replaces inherited fixed lengths and, when no case rate is declared, clears inherited rate policy. Same-case contradictory declarations remain errors and SAL stays within [1,S+1]. The template no longer requires acceptance rates; all-no-rate Excel/HTML reports hide the unused rate column. Legacy explicit Neff/rate configurations and timing formulas remain supported.

Final selected-rank CSA/HCA/SWA stages add optional operator drill-downs. Integer-nanosecond, all-stream clipped sweeps retain named parallel multiplicities and no-record gaps; source means use the parent reference layers and retained rounds, including zero for proven absent fingerprints. Native names, shapes, dtypes, streams and original row examples remain traceable. Existing Dispatch/Combine/GMM deltas are separate signed model entries; original cycle, TPOT, throughput, rank selection and ten-stage/U accounting are unchanged. Method1/2 sheets and HTML show closed Top-N coverage/model ledgers and separate nonadditive source-kernel hotspots, with readable labels, explicit aggregate remainders and old-report fallback. Only final selected-rank groups export operator detail, with source aggregation cached across methods; no private capture or detailed analysis is included.

Operator labels in both method sheets and HTML retain complete parent-stage and operator type names, input shapes and streams with explicit wrapping. Full native names, output shapes and dtypes stay visible in source columns. Table and chart heights follow text length; continuation rows preserve long evidence and charts retain their original values. This renderer-only update can redraw existing operator-bearing JSON without resampling or changing core estimates, rankings or Top-N limits.

Method1/2 sheets add fine main_inputs/main_metadata device-interval ledgers, pinned static function-entry references and one fixed selected-rank HC-round line chart with missing values preserved. New CSV exports retain every captured rank and original HC identity. Source Top8 kernels add whole-call Duration-weighted optional PMU counters, per-metric coverage and conservative AIC/AIV/MIX bound evidence without changing old timings, rankings, parent boundaries or extrapolation. Unknown counters remain unknown; non-ratio percent units and incomplete active-core time evidence cannot produce false bound diagnoses. Standard-library runtime and legacy JSON rendering remain supported; all private captures and generated reports remain local.

Case analysis uses a bounded spawn process pool (automatic maximum two, CPU/cgroup and low-memory budgets, --workers 1 for serial). Each case immediately finalizes both methods and releases prepared operator evidence; only private temporary-file identities cross IPC, and result/failure order stays deterministic. Rank coverage and all diagnostics remain intact. Bounded PMU value parsing and validated native PMU reuse reduce repeated work, exact Decimal trace timestamps avoid reparsing, and case/rank stage timing logs expose progress. Serial/spawn equivalence and Windows CLI/spawn CI are included; source/target timing, rank selection and all extrapolation formulas remain unchanged.

Optional --parallel rank schedules every case/rank on one global spawn pool, with --workers as its total budget. Full case context and coverage are planned once; rank results spool privately, then each complete case is assembled in original rank order, finalized immediately, and released. Original duplicate-CSV and first preparation-error ordering, mean-rank tie selection, source and target formulas, and all successful-case CSV evidence are preserved. Default case parallelism remains compatible, including explicit nine-case concurrency. Windows CI also exercises rank concurrency and full serial/rank result equivalence.

Source baseline and both extrapolation methods add editable BS/S sweep tables and line charts while preserving the nine-sheet workbook and offline HTML. Fixed-BS S comparisons retain each case configured Neff and existing rank choices; whole-cycle latency is explicitly an ITL round-interval proxy, not measured per-token delivery latency. Source headline values remain aggregate originals, and a pure source-only helper derives TPOT and five measured parts from the selected source rank exact layer boundaries including main0; missing or nonclosing evidence stays unknown. Old JSON redraw requires no CSV or trace reads, changes no report objects or target formulas, preserves duplicate points without ambiguous curves and missing points as gaps. Independent chart-cache, table-reference, source-rank isolation, alias-validation, and Windows sweep regression checks are included.

Both methods now share one rank per case selected before extrapolation from the maximum retained source full-cycle mean, including main0 and all original main/draft chains, gaps and residual. Ties preserve original source input order, all per-rank target estimates and formulas remain, and final cards, five parts, stages, U/step and operator/PMU evidence use the shared rank; target-model maxima are no longer selected. Explicit source-rank metadata and incomplete-coverage scope accompany results, with honest unavailable-method references. Optional renderer --align-source-rank performs pure offline reselection from stored per-rank results into a separate JSON/XLSX/HTML without CSV rereads or input mutation, preserving only verified same-method/same-rank operator evidence and leaving absent PMU unknown. Direct legacy redraw preserves original values and labels the old policy. Reversal, tie, mean, physical-card, evidence-provenance, metadata-conflict, CLI and Windows regression checks cover the change.

Public NPU performance Skill/code survey pins 13 repositories and records licenses, assumptions and rejected heuristics. Independent operator screening now checks role-specific MAC/VEC/Scalar/MTE1/MTE2/MTE3/Fixpipe completeness, same-call joint coverage and saved per-call diagnostics; missing evidence never defaults to compute-bound. Forty-four explicitly documented memory, bandwidth, cache and operation fields retain product/unit/export-row provenance, with arithmetic amount statistics separate from Duration-weighted activity. Method1/2 Top8 tables expose MTE1/Fixpipe and a separate explicit source-logical-NPU Roofline model; dtype peaks, fixed effective work, memory level and source case/rank/fingerprint are validated, and inconsistent or absent models remain explicit. Optional --refresh-bound updates old JSON without CSV reads or timing/rank changes, with separate derived JSON/XLSX/HTML and evidence templates. The nine-sheet layout, standard-library Windows runtime, parallelism and all source/target timing formulas remain; regression and independent adversarial review cover provenance, units, coverage, overflow and input protection.

Display-only BS/S trend consolidation groups comparable fixed-parameter curves per method and metric, with independent whole-cycle/ITL-proxy and five-part charts on both method sheets. Model, topology, coverage and sampling provenance remain isolated; duplicate coordinates disable only the ambiguous curve, missing values remain gaps, and nearly equal parameters keep distinct labels. Selected-rank HC-round source tables move to the source baseline with exact cross-sheet chart references and legacy-rank isolation. Excel adds native internal links and case/chart/table directories; offline HTML adds a searchable directory, safe fragment targets and automatic details expansion. Duplicate legacy case names, long text, nested charts, malicious labels and link validation are covered. Existing JSON redraw requires no CSV or trace reads, leaves input objects and source/target timing/rank values unchanged, retains nine sheets and the standard-library Windows runtime. Synthetic nine-case and local old-report smoke checks preserve chart/table contents and input hashes; generated/private artifacts remain local.

Method3 retains each target layer Dispatch/Combine duration with multipliers exactly one and no fixed overhead, while applying the existing routed-GMM TopK delta; target depth, gaps, source-rank selection and original methods remain unchanged. New raw analyses export three methods and ten workbook sheets. Optional --add-method3 derives means from validated saved source aggregates into separate JSON/XLSX/HTML without CSV rereads, input mutation or fabricated per-round observations; missing source evidence remains unavailable. All three methods share BS/S trends, five parts, stages, source-linked U charts, operator/PMU evidence and navigation. HTML directory anchors now assemble in one ordered pass instead of repeatedly copying the whole document, retaining exact content and adding body/directory/write progress. Core, renderer, CLI, legacy JSON, source provenance, closure, chart caches, serial/spawn equivalence and Windows regression checks are included; real old-report and nine-case synthetic smoke artifacts stay local.

New analyses define acceptance as the mean effective output fraction including bonus: SAL=(1+S)*r, canonical semantics mean_output_fraction_including_bonus. Each case may override its rate; changes in S recompute inherited rate-derived lengths, explicit SAL-only cases remain supported, conflicting Neff/SAL/r declarations and active historical semantics are rejected with migration guidance. Strict output/rate endpoints handle the representable 1/3 boundary without admitting lower floats. Source and all three methods use the derived Neff for throughput and TPOT; original cycle, five-part, stage and rank calculations remain unchanged. CSV, Excel, HTML, templates and the independent capture validator share the definition. Existing JSON is never reinterpreted, old formulas stay labeled and new/old/different-rate trend conditions remain separate. Pure configuration preview exposes declared rates without inventing Neff or performance. Core/validator parity, boundary, inheritance, input immutability, historical method3 preservation and real CLI synthetic sensitivity regressions cover the update, including Windows checks.
